text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah...
Things have gotten really bad, yeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"To think it would jump right
out of the room...ugh!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I-If anyone sees us,
we are SO deaaaad...!!

A large bird gazed down at El Condor Pasa
from the rooftop of the student dormitory.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Found youuuu! Wait right there, Mambo!
You must NOT move from that spot, NO WAY!!
